identification: Framed colour reproduction print of a Russell Drysdale painting of a seated woman in a straw hat with white collar and gloves, 50 x 40 cm, in a pale timber frame. It is a print, not an original. Backing carries an Italian-language Drysdale biography/caption slip and a J.M. & J.N. Cocker picture frame makers label (20 The Quadrant, Launceston, phone 2 2789). The specific painting title was not identified; the Italian caption refers to a Drysdale work called 'Donna di Campagna' (Country Woman), which may be this image.
